reasoning_traces.think:
The core innovation lies in decoupling premise evaluation from numerical probability. Concept premises are now scored along a new axis where skill is defined as excess agreement over random chance. This avoids probabilistic assumptions while preserving calibration. The system distinguishes between measurable and proxy concepts, ensuring that only valid measures contribute to the score. Conditional premises are excluded due to lack of threshold data, maintaining integrity. The registry formalizes how context tags map to database surfaces, enabling scalable extension without recompilation. The residual loop applies Brier-style skill correction, aligning with prior probability-axis logic but extended to conceptual domains.
